name: Rixos Downtown Antalya - The Land Of Legends Access

descriptions.en: Rixos Downtown Antalya is located in Ataturk Culture Park. The provider describes views of the sea and Taurus Mountains, rooms with balconies, a lagoon-style pool, dining outlets, a gym and tennis courts. A Turkish bath, spa massages and a shuttle to the private beach and Land of Legends Theme Park are also mentioned. Confirm inclusions and access conditions in your room offer.
descriptions.tr: Rixos Downtown Antalya, Atatürk Kültür Parkı’nda yer alıyor. Sağlayıcı açıklamasında deniz ve Toros Dağları manzarası, balkonlu odalar, lagün tarzı havuz, yemek mekanları, spor salonu ve tenis kortları bulunuyor. Hamam, spa masajları, özel plaja ve Land of Legends tema parkına servis de belirtiliyor. Dahil hizmetleri ve erişim koşullarını oda teklifinde doğrula.
descriptions.de: Rixos Downtown Antalya liegt im Atatürk-Kulturpark. Der Anbieter beschreibt Meer- und Taurusblick, Zimmer mit Balkon, einen Lagunenpool, gastronomische Angebote, ein Fitnessstudio und Tennisplätze. Genannt werden auch ein türkisches Bad, Spa-Massagen und ein Shuttle zum Privatstrand und zum Themenpark Land of Legends. Prüfe Leistungen und Zugangsbedingungen im Zimmerangebot.
descriptions.fr: Rixos Downtown Antalya se situe dans le parc culturel Atatürk. Il mentionne aussi un hammam, des massages et une navette vers la plage privée et Land of Legends. Vérifie les inclusions et conditions d’accès dans l’offre.

Также указаны турецкая баня, массаж в спа и трансфер к частному пляжу и парку Land of Legends. Уточняй включённые услуги и условия доступа в предложении номера.
descriptions.ar: يقع Rixos Downtown Antalya في منتزه أتاتورك الثقافي. يصف المورد إطلالات على البحر وجبال طوروس وغرفاً بشرفات ومسبحاً على طراز البحيرة ومطاعم وصالة رياضية وملاعب تنس. ويذكر حماماً تركياً وتدليكاً في السبا وخدمة نقل إلى الشاطئ الخاص ومنتزه Land of Legends. تحقق من الخدمات المشمولة وشروط الدخول في عرض الغرفة.

descriptions.ko: Rixos Downtown Antalya는 아타튀르크 문화공원에 있습니다. 호텔 정보에는 바다와 타우루스산맥 전망, 발코니가 있는 객실, 라군 형태의 수영장, 식음 시설, 체육관과 테니스 코트가 소개되어 있습니다. 터키식 목욕탕, 스파 마사지, 전용 해변과 Land of Legends Theme Park행 셔틀도 언급되어 있습니다. 포함된 서비스와 이용 조건은 선택한 객실 상품에서 확인하세요.
descriptions.pl: Rixos Downtown Antalya znajduje się w parku kultury im. Atatürka. Opis obiektu wymienia widoki na morze i góry Taurus, pokoje z balkonami, basen w stylu laguny, restauracje, siłownię i korty tenisowe. Wskazano również łaźnię turecką, masaże spa oraz transfer na prywatną plażę i do parku rozrywki Land of Legends. Zakres usług i warunki dostępu sprawdź w wybranej ofercie pokoju.

source.description: Luxurious Accommodation in Ataturk Culture Park Exotic Dining and Recreation Fitness and Wellness Amenities Experience 5-star luxury at our hotel nestled in Ataturk Culture Park, offering stunning views of the sea and Taurus Mountains. Indulge in exquisite dining at our multiple outlets and unwind by the lagoon-style pool. Stay active at our modern gym and tennis courts, then relax in the Turkish bath or with a massage at the spa. Don't miss out on our shuttle service to the private beach and the Land of Legends Theme Park. With elegant rooms featuring balconies and upscale amenities, your stay with us will be unforgettable. Book now for a truly exceptional experience.
